description: DNS records of a domain over DNS-over-HTTPS (Cloudflare, with Google Public DNS as fallback): A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SOA, CAA, or all of them. Returns each record with its TTL, the resolver used, the DMARC record and DNSSEC status. The full report is at report_url (/dns?name=<name> on iplover.com).

language.description: Language of the human-readable fields (verdict, explanation, labels).

name: dns_lookup

queries.description: One entry per record type: status, records (name, type, ttl, value), error, resolver.

report_url.description: Public iplover page with the full report for these records: share it, or open it for the explanations and sources.

title: Look up DNS records
